name: Psychoenergetic Talent (Dromite)
body:
–

Benefit: Your natural ability to create rays of energy is heightened, allowing you to fire a weakened version of energy ray as a standard action as long as you maintain psionic focus. This energy ray instead deals 1d3 points of damage of the energy type of your caste. Your manifester level for this ability is always 1.

Special: Only Dromites may take this Racial trait.
